correctness.rationale: For each n root parameter θ=θ_n stays fixed during that tree; θ/n→c>0. Conditional attachment probabilities p_j=θ/(θ+j−1), q_j=L_j/(θ+j−1), and disjoint root and leaf-parent categories yield bounded centered martingale increments ξ_B=I−p, ξ_L=−(J−q). Leaf centered recursion multiplies prior value by 1−1/(θ+j−1), telescoping to terminal coefficient b_{j,n}=(θ+j−1)/(θ+n−2). Exact joint conditional covariance matrix has entries p(1−p), b p q, b² q(1−q); the positive off diagonal is justified by mutually exclusive categories. Var(L_j)≤(j−2)/4 yields uniformly vanishing q_j−E q_j in L1 for θ∼cn; predictable quadratic variations are Riemann sums over p(x)=c/(c+x),q(x)=x(x+2c)/[2(c+x)²],b(x)=(c+x)/(c+1). Integrals give U(c)=c[log(1+1/c)−1/(c+1)],K(c)=c/[2(c+1)²],V(c)=(6c²+4c+1)/[12(c+1)³]. Bounded increments satisfy martingale Lindeberg; Cramér–Wold gives bivariate CLT. Three strictly positive attachment-category probabilities for x>0 ensure positive definite Σc. Finite exact E L and Cov formula verified independently by enumerating all n=4,θ=2 parent choices, yielding E L=9/4,Cov=3/8. This is finite corroboration, not proof of CLT.
